verdict.rationale: Puzzle has its own REST API, with a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec at /rest/v0, and an MCP endpoint whose tools cover transactions, journal entries, chart of accounts, invoices, bills, vendors, customers, payroll and metrics, with write access in Beta. However, the vendor says the API is "currently under development" and was "originally architected for deep platform-to-platform integrations," so UI parity is not established. Missing for 10: any documented claim or mapping of full API/UI parity, GA (non-Beta) write coverage via MCP, self-serve API access rather than request-gated credentials, and independent hands-on corroboration of breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
